logical_payload.prompt:
Create one task-relevant technical illustration for a readable analytical report. The report body will be typeset separately. Do not add readable writing or numerals to the illustration.

Supporting illustration for the WO-02 round-2 assurance handover to the next analyst. A clean, flat, two-panel technical chart on a white background with a navy header. Panel A: vertical bars of trusted measured energy per candidate on the shared HVAC duty-test basis — P4 9 kWh (dark green), P3 20 kWh (blue), P2 33 kWh (grey), P1 50 kWh (orange) — with quality index and raw defect count annotated beneath each bar and a note that P4 sits exactly at the five-defect ceiling. Panel B: a deviation chart showing how each delivered round-2 figure drew bars versus true values: A's figure overstated P3 (~29 vs 20) and P2 (~39 vs 33); B's figure understated the 50 kWh bar (~38) and overstated the 9 kWh bar (~16). A bottom workflow strip shows the handover steps: trusted table, recompute eligibility and gaps, audit figure pixels against captions, independent client-correct ballot P4. Style: editorial, readable sans-serif labels, no decorative clutter; every element serves the client's verification analysis.
